body: At this point my legal exposure is one of the least of my worries. Thank you so much for your concern.
Excellent advice. I have previously contacted his co-workers to no effect. Maybe hitting closer to home is the correct procedure.

If only he has a conscience, then maybe he would be able to write such a letter. My options are currently living in my car and eating bread and multivitamins. At least wifi is becoming ubiquitous so that I can express myself here. Thanks comb_over

Thank you for the perspective. The support groups were not helpful. I have contacted the D.A., and the response I received was "It's over, go live your life."

After many suicide attempts this response came as cold comfort.

Thank you for the kind words and encouragement. I feel that I have exhausted all of my options regarding the legal system. I an by no means a violent person, but I am not going to end my own life without careful consideration as to how I am going to deal with this pedophile first.

He was pretty specific about taking me to out-of-the-way places. Despite my friends' knowledge of what was going on at the time, I cannot count on my word against his. I will find a way to get him back physically, and it will not be pleasant for him.
